```json
{
  "subtype": "exploratory_data_analysis",
  "focus_variable": "hardware_incident",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "device_type",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Extracted device categories (printer, server, keyboard vs software/database) are well-separated, interpretable groups directly comparable against hardware vs non-hardware, an ideal EDA segmentation variable."
    },
    {
      "name": "failure_mode",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Distinct failure descriptors (overheating, flickering, crashing, connection_error) are interpretable categories that plausibly associate differently with hardware vs software incidents, supporting meaningful grouping."
    },
    {
      "name": "affected_component",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Component classes (physical_hardware, storage, power_thermal, network, display_output) are clean, interpretable segments strongly associational with hardware status; high NULL rate slightly weakens coverage but categories remain informative."
    },
    {
      "name": "physical_state_keyword",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Boolean flag for presence of physical-state language is interpretable and directly hypothesizes a description signal for hardware, with a reasonable 185/415 split enabling comparison."
    },
    {
      "name": "problem_specificity",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "An ordinal 1-5 specificity scale is interpretable and can be segmented, though its link to hardware is weaker and the tail (4,5) is sparse; borderline but usable for exploration."
    },
    {
      "name": "location_mentioned",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Boolean indicating a location reference is interpretable and separable; physical incidents may mention locations, giving a plausible if secondary associational signal."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 6,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.82,
  "rationale": "As a set, these columns extract external, interpretable descriptive attributes (device, failure mode, component, physical/location cues) that can each be grouped and compared against the hardware focus, directly serving the query about what description signals hardware problems. Categories are well-separated and human-readable rather than opaque scores. Minor weaknesses lower the score: several columns carry high NULL rates (affected_component 270, failure_mode 138), problem_specificity's tail is near-constant, and physical_state_keyword/location_mentioned are coarse booleans, but none merely restate the focus and the set strongly supports interpretable relationship discovery."
}
```
